title: Running Commentary on Torah 47 — Va'Achaltem Achol v'Savo'a
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 47 — ואכלתם אכול ושבוע
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Opening**: **"Va'achaltem achol v'savo'a, v'hillaltem"** (Yoel 2:26). One sunk in **ta'avas achilah** is known to be far from **emes**, **dinim reign**, is **dal**, and **ends in bizyonos+bushos** — **'k'rum zulos li'v'nei adam'** (Tehillim 12:9) — Berachos 6b: **'keivan she'nitzrach adam la'b'riyos, nishtaneh panav k'krum.'** **"Know: one who breaks ta'avas achilah — HKBH does mofsim through him.** Chazal (Berachos 20a): **'asher lo yisa panim'** (Devarim 10:17) vs **'yisa Hashem panav'** (Bamidbar 6:26) — 'v'chi lo essa panim... Ani amarti va'achalta v'sava'ta u'verachta — v'hen m'dakdekim al atzman mi'k'zayis v'ad k'beitzah.'"**

intermediate.en: **"Va'achaltem achol v'savo'a..."** (Yoel 2:26). Ta'avas achilah→far emes/dinim/dalus/bushos (Teh 12:9 "k'rum zulos"; Ber 6b). Breaking → mofsim via him (Ber 20a: nisa panim because m'dakdekim k'zayis-k'beitzah).
intermediate.he: **"ואכלתם אכול ושבוע..."** (יואל ב, כו). ת"א→רחוק מאמת/דינים/דלות/בושות (תה' יב, ט "כרום זולות"; בר' ו:). שבירה→מופתים (בר' כ: נושא פנים כי מדקדקים כזית-כביצה).

scholarly.he: יואל ב, כו; תה' יב, ט; בר' ו:, כ.

beginner.en: **"**EY = received from bechina of Yaakov** — **'va'yeishev Yaakov b'eretz'** (Bereshis 37:1). Called **Eretz ha'Chayim** (Zohar Vayikra 45b). **Tefillin=chayim** — **'Hashem aleihem yichyu'** (Yeshayahu 38:16; Menachos 44b). **Shevachah**: **'asher lo v'miskeinus tochal bah lachem'** (Devarim 8:9) — not eating lechem out of aniyus; EY's lechem comes from **emes**-level, not out of need."**

intermediate.en: **β. EY=bechina Yaakov=Eretz ha'Chayim** (Zohar Vay 45b); **tefillin=chayim** (Yesh 38:16; Men 44b); "lo b'miskeinus tochal bah lachem" (Dev 8:9) — from emes, not need.
intermediate.he: **β. א"י=בחינת יעקב=ארץ החיים** (זוה"ק ויק' מה:); **תפילין=חיים** (יש' לח, טז; מנ' מד:); "לא במסכנות תאכל בה לחם" (דב' ח, ט) — מאמת, לא מצורך.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. זוה"ק ויק' מה:; יש' לח, טז; מנ' מד:; דב' ח, ט.

beginner.en: **"When one blemishes **emes** = **kelalus ha'gonin** → **bushah** (Zohar Emor 89b; Tikkun 58) = **aniyus** (**'k'rum zulos l'b'nei adam'**; panim change colors k'krum)."**

intermediate.en: Pgam emes=kelalus gonin → bushah (Zohar Emor 89b; Tik 58)=aniyus ("k'rum zulos"; panim change).
intermediate.he: פגם אמת=כלל גוונים → בושה (זוה"ק אמור פט:; תיקון נח)=עניות ("כרום זולות"; פנים משתנים).

beginner.en: **"We receive shefa through **EY**. EY's shefa = **he'aras pnei Yaakov=he'aras ha'tefillin**. Therefore of EY: **'ha'notein imrei shefer'** (Bereshis 49:21). **Shefer=pa'ar=tefillin** — she gives us **osiyos-he'arah she'kiblah mei'tefillin**."** **"Peirush: **'r'eh chayim im ishah'** (Kohelet 9:9). **ISHaH** = r"t **ha'Notein Imrei Shefer** — **'r'eh chayim'** dayka: tefillin=chayim. **'Naftali ayalah sh'luchah'** (Bereshis 49:21) — **Naftali = osiyos tefilin**."**

intermediate.en: Shefa via EY=he'aras pnei Yaakov=tefillin. "Ha'notein imrei shefer" (Ber 49:21): shefer=pa'ar=tefillin → osiyos-he'arah. "R'eh chayim im ishah" (Koh 9:9): ISHaH=r"t Ha'notein Imrei Shefer; chayim=tefillin. Naftali=osiyos tefilin.
intermediate.he: שפע דרך א"י=הארת פני יעקב=תפילין. "הנותן אמרי שפר" (בר' מט, כא): שפר=פאר=תפילין → אותיות הארה. "ראה חיים עם אשה" (קה' ט, ט): אש"ה=ר"ת הנותן אמרי שפר; חיים=תפילין. נפתלי=אותיות תפילין.

scholarly.he: בר' מט, כא; קה' ט, ט.

beginner.en: **"When we eat **shefa-emes** via EY, then declare Hashem's praise with this strength — **new heavens v'eretz chadashah** are made. Chazal (Hakdamas ha'Zohar 5a): **'le'mor l'Tziyon ami atah'** — **al tikrei ami ela imi, b'shutfi** (partner with Me). **New shamayim** via **he'aras pnei Yaakov**; **new aretz** via EY-shefa flow. He thereby creates **new shamayim+mazalos**, altering the prior natural order."**

intermediate.en: Eating shefa-emes via EY + praise → **new shamayim+aretz** (Hakd Zohar 5a "ami→imi, b'shutfi"). New shamayim=he'aras pnei Yaakov; new aretz=EY-shefa → altered mazalos.
intermediate.he: אכילת שפע־אמת דרך א"י + הילול → **שמים+ארץ חדשים** (הקד' זוה"ק ה. "עמי→עימי, בשותפי"). שמים חדשים=הארת פני יעקב; ארץ חדשה=שפע א"י → מזלות חדשים.

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"I wrote this Torah first from my own memory, finding some matters clarified more. The **peirush of 'va'achaltem'** is missing in his holy language here; what's missing in one is revealed in the other. Hence I also copy my own version:"**

intermediate.en: R"N: first from memory + from kisvei kodesh; sections complement.

beginner.en: **"**'Va'achaltem achol v'savo'a, v'hilaltem es shem Hashem Elokeichem'** (Yoel 2:26). One who **exited ta'avas achilah** can be **ish mofes**. Sunk in ta'avas achilah = **shakran** (liar). Even a tzaddik who has exited but **falls back into ta'avas achilah** — **sheker emerges from his mouth** — sign of **din above** + **aniyus**."**

**"**'Ve'achalta ve'savata u'veirachta'** (Devarim 8:10): seemingly YH"R's claim — eat+fill+bless. But Chazal (Berachos 20a): **'asher lo yisa panim... Ani amarti va'achalta v'sava'ta u'veirachta — v'hein m'dakdekim al atzman mi'k'zayis v'ad k'beitzah'** — wondrous hint: if Israel limit themselves to k'zayis-k'beitzah (smallest amounts), they are in bechina of **nesi'as panim**."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Dev 8:10 "v'achalta v'savata u'veirachta"** — Ber 20a: nisa panim because limiting to k'zayis-k'beitzah.
intermediate.he: **ו. דב' ח, י "ואכלת ושבעת וברכת"** — בר' כ: נושא פנים בגלל הקפדה כזית-כביצה.

beginner.en: **"The whole world is nourished from **EY's shefa**. EY receives from **emes=middas Yaakov** — **'titten emes l'Yaakov'** (Michah 7:20) = **middas tif'eres=kelalus ha'gonin=shamayim=esh+mayim**. Hinted in **'eretz ocheles yoshveha'** (Bamidbar 13:32): difficulty — true the meraglim lied, but how was their sheker written in the Torah? The resolution: **these words hinted truths** even as they lied."**

intermediate.en: **η. World from EY-shefa**. EY←emes=Yaakov (Michah 7:20) = tif'eres=kelalus gonin=shamayim=esh+mayim. "Eretz ocheles yoshveha" (Bam 13:32) hints truths despite meraglim's sheker.
intermediate.he: **ז. עולם משפע א"י**. א"י←אמת=יעקב (מיכה ז, כ) = תפארת=כלל גוונים=שמים=אש+מים. "ארץ אוכלת יושביה" (במ' יג, לב) מרמזת אמתות חרף שקר מרגלים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. מיכה ז, כ; במ' יג, לב.

beginner.en: **"**'R'eh chayim im ishah'** (Kohelet 9:9): **ISHaH=r"t Ha'notein Imrei Shefer; chayim=tefillin** (Menachos 44b on 'Hashem aleihem yichyu'; **'v'ra'u kol amei ha'aretz ki shem Hashem nikra alecha'** Devarim 28:10; Berachos 6a)."**

scholarly.he: קה' ט, ט; מנ' מד:; דב' כח, י; בר' ו.

beginner.en: **"**'Eretz asher lo b'miskeinus tochal bah lachem'** (Devarim 8:9) — **eretz=bechina emes**; he'aras panim; no **tafnukim** (luxuries). **'Lo b'miskeinus'** — not from aniyus; **'tochal lachem'** — not other delicacies. He eats just **lechem** because he's on emes-level, detached from ta'avas achilah. **EY=Eretz ha'Chayim** — shefa from Yaakov (**'Yaakov avinu lo meis,'** Ta'anis 5b) = bechina of tefillin (chayim)."**

intermediate.en: **ι. "Eretz lo b'miskeinus tochal lachem"** (Dev 8:9) — emes+he'aras panim; not tafnukim, not miskeinus. **EY=Eretz Chayim** (Yaakov lo meis, Ta'an 5b)=tefillin.
intermediate.he: **ט. "ארץ לא במסכנות תאכל לחם"** (דב' ח, ט) — אמת+הארת פנים; לא תפנוקים, לא מסכנות. **א"י=ארץ החיים** (יעקב לא מת, תענ' ה:)=תפילין.

beginner.en: **"Wonders in Chazal (Berachos 24a) on **'v'hayu chayecha t'luim'** (Devarim 28:66): **'zeh ha'toleh tefilav'**. Also Menachos 103b: **'zeh ha'koneh min ha'palter'**. Unified: one who hangs tefillin=blemishes emes/nesi'as panim → hester panim → parnasah diminished → **must buy from palter** (baker instead of baking at home)."**

intermediate.en: **κ. Ber 24a "v'hayu chayecha t'luim"=ha'toleh tefilav; Men 103b=ha'koneh min ha'palter**. Same: pogem tefillin→hester→buy from palter.
intermediate.he: **י. בר' כד "והיו חייך תלואים"=התולה תפיליו; מנ' קג:=הקונה מן הפלטר**. אחד: פגם תפילין→הסתר→פלטר.

scholarly.he: בר' כד; מנ' קג:; דב' כח, סו.

beginner.en: **"When the tzaddik eats **l'sabei'a nafsho** (not from gashmi ta'avah), he is in bechina of **nesi'as panim** and is nourished from **middas emes**. When with koach of that eating he stands **l'hodos u'l'halel Hashem** — **divrei emes** emerge = **Yaakov=tif'eres=kelalus gonin=shamayim v'aretz** = **EY**. Therefore with this koach he becomes **shutaf l'HKBH b'vri'as shamayim va'aretz** — his **divrei kedushah** create new shamayim+aretz (via emes)."**

intermediate.en: **λ. Tzaddik's eating l'sabei'a nafsho=nesi'as panim, nourished from emes. Praise with that koach → divrei emes = Yaakov=tif'eres=shamayim+aretz → shutaf creating new.
intermediate.he: **λ. צדיק אוכל לשובע נפשו=נשיאת פנים, ניזון מאמת. הילול בכוח → דברי אמת = יעקב=תפארת=שמים+ארץ → שותף יוצר חדש.
